issue.title: Add an 'XPrompt Target' glossary entry for the ACE prompt-bar targeting state
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-hp.6 (epic sase-hp, docs phase) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. That phase could not act on it: sase/memory/*.md edits require explicit user permission in the conversation, and the epic plan (plans:202608/xprompt_target_mode.md, 'Cross-cutting constraints') forbade every phase from touching memory files or the glossary. Filed here so the owner can grant or decline it.

WHAT: epic sase-hp introduced 'target' as a user-facing noun for a new prompt-input-bar state, and it is now the word used throughout docs/ace.md's 'Editing an Existing XPrompt from the TUI' section, docs/xprompt.md, the '?' help modal ('Edit definition here (target)', 'Save to targeted xprompt'), and the bar's own chrome. sase/memory/glossary.md has no entry for it, so agents reading Tier 1 memory meet the term only in code.

PROPOSED ENTRY: 'XPrompt Target' -- the prompt input bar bound to a specific editable definition file (an xprompt, an xprompt memory note, or a skill source). A targeted bar shows a canonical reference chip (the string a user would type: '#foo', '#memory/foo', '/skill-name') with clean / dirty / read-only / changed-on-disk states and a doubled border, offers a target-aware Enter chooser plus a 'gw' / 'Ctrl+G w' single-key save, resolves writes through sase.xprompt.write_targets (redirecting home paths to the chezmoi source when use_chezmoi is on), and then offers only the follow-up actions the written file needs -- commit/push, a scoped 'chezmoi apply', 'sase memory init', or 'sase skill init'.

VERIFY BEFORE WRITING: confirm the shipped behavior against docs/ace.md#editing-an-existing-xprompt-from-the-tui and src/sase/xprompt/write_targets.py rather than copying this description verbatim. Note that sase's own sase/memory/glossary.md is hand-written (no 'sase_generated: glossary' frontmatter marker and no 'glossary:' key in sase/sase.yml), so this is a hand edit, not a sase.yml config entry -- unlike the project-local generated glossary notes added by 01fa3b106. After the edit, 'sase memory init' must be run to regenerate AGENTS.md and the provider instruction shims.
